EVERYONE IS WELCOME IN BROOKHAVEN
Brookhaven is a town built by everyone in it. A place where everyone belongs. A place for community, discovery, and curiosity.
Create Your World.
Houses, shops, a school, a hospital, the works. Run a cafe today, a fire station tomorrow. Pick where you live. Drive any car you want. It's all yours.
Play with New and Old Friends.
There are millions of players a day in Brookhaven. Some are throwing birthday parties. Some are hanging out at the fountain. Your friends are probably already here.
Explore and Discover.
Brookhaven has a secret. People have been finding pieces of it for years. Strange doors. Glowing rooms. Stuff that wasn't there yesterday. Solve Brookhaven mysteries.
WELCOME TO BROOKHAVEN!
Create, discover, role play and explore in Brookhaven- it's your world!

Backpack Storage & Releaser Refresh!
Post by
Jesse Raen
Published:
Fri, Aug 21, 2026
Happy update day! This week, two new pets have joined Adoption Island and there's a new way to organize your backpack!
New Releaser Pets!
There are two new Legendary pets for you to collect! Release pets for tickets and spend them on Basic & Crystal Eggs for the chance at collecting the:
🥝 Kiwi Kiwi -
Legendary
🍓 Strawberry Tortle -
Legendary
Backpack Storage!
Tired of digging through your backpack to find the pet you were raising? Did you fill your backpack with cheap cheese and you wish you could get rid of the smell? With Backpack Storage, you can!
Storage gives you a brand new space to place your items
outside
of your backpack. You can move items between your Backpack and Storage whenever you want!
For maximum convenience you can select multiple items and move them all at once!
Storage Tabs!
You can organize your Storage by Tabs, giving each one a unique name and an icon from the Journal! You can have up to 25 Tabs at once, making it easier than ever to sort hundreds or even thousands of times!
You can access Storage while trading and give players access to view your Storage inventory, meaning you only have to keep the pets you're actively raising,
or flexing!
Play Adopt Me Now!

!

Lucky Surprise
and
Lucky Block
pets!
The
Lucky Block Angelus
is the
rarest
hatch of all!
🐣 Lucky Eggs
Hatch your way through
5 Lucky Eggs
!
Upgrade
Better Eggs to unlock the next one.
The top egg even hatches rotating
Active Huge
pets!
The
Blue Lucky Egg
hides the
rarest
pets of all!
Event
❔ Lucky Blocks
Lucky Blocks come in
9 colors
, each tougher than the last!
Smash one and it
steps down
a color instead of breaking.
The toughest blocks take
9 solid hits
to clear!
Smashed blocks drop
Breakout Coins
,
Diamonds
, and
items
!
Every block hides a tiny shot at a
HUGE
,
TITANIC
, or
GARGANTUAN
!
🧰 Lucky Chests
The
TITANIC
and
GARG Chest
sits right by your board!
Claim each one every
hour
for its
chase pet
!
The
GARGANTUAN Lucky Block Angelus
and
TITANIC Lucky Block Tiger
await!
Level
Chest Luck
for better odds!
🎁 Lucky Bag
Crack open the brand-new
Lucky Bag
for
loot
!
Push your luck for the
HUGE Lucky Stacked Elephant
inside!
Smash
Lucky Blocks
for a rare shot at one!
⚡ Lucky Boosts
Supercharge your board with
Lucky Boosts
- tier I and II!
Lucky Damage
- Your pets hit Lucky Blocks way harder
Lucky Speed
- Your pets bounce around the board faster
Lucky Egg Booster
- Better luck on every Lucky Egg you hatch
Stack
them up before a
deep run
!
⬆️ Breakout Upgrades
Your board starts
empty
, so buy that first
slot
!
Clear stages for
Breakout Bucks
, then spend them at the machine!
Stack
Pet Slots
up to
100
, then boost
Pet Power
and
Pet Speed
!
Unlock
Better Eggs
and squeeze more
Breakout Coins
from every block!
Chest Luck
sharpens your
GARGANTUAN
and
TITANIC
odds!
A
packed
board beats a strong one, so keep buying slots!
👥 Visit Islands
Check out any other
board
on the island!
Open the
Teleport Machine
and pick a player to visit.
Tap
Home
any time to head straight back!
🤖 Free Autos
Everyone gets
Auto Tap
,
Auto Hatch
, and
Auto Rebirth
inside the arena!
No gamepass needed, they're completely
FREE
.
Auto Rebirth
restarts the climb the moment you clear
100
!
Your pets keep bouncing, so it's perfect for
AFK
!
Contests
🏆 Breakout Leaderboard
Push as
deep
as you can up the
Breakout Leaderboard
!
Only
brand-new
stages count, so keep pushing forward.
Every
Rebirth
keeps your total, so you never lose ground!
#1-3 Place:
Rainbow Shiny Titanic Lucky Peacock
#4-10 Place:
Golden Shiny Titanic Lucky Peacock
#11-100 Place:
Rainbow Titanic Lucky Peacock
#101-250 Place:
Shiny Titanic Lucky Peacock
#251-500 Place:
Golden Titanic Lucky Peacock
#501-1,000 Place:
Titanic Lucky Peacock
#1,001-10,000 Place:
Huge Lucky Surprise Ducky
Good luck!
⚔️ Royal Clan Battle
Battle it out as a
team
in the
Royal Clan Battle
!
Every
Boss Lucky Block
you beat
scores
for your clan.
Only your
first
clear of each boss counts!
Win the
GARGANTUAN Stealth Dragon
and
TITANIC Royal Cloud Cat
!
Plus, the
Royal Hoverboard
and
Royal Booth
!
The battle runs for
7 days
.
#1 Place:
Gargantuan Stealth Dragon
#2-3 Place:
Rainbow Titanic Royal Cloud Cat
#4-10 Place:
Golden Titanic Royal Cloud Cat
#11-50 Place:
Titanic Royal Cloud Cat
#51-250 Place:
Huge Royal Cloud Corgi
Top 30:
Royal Hoverboard
Top 50:
Royal Booth
Top 500:
Clan Gift
Gold Medal:
#1 Clan
Silver Medal:
#2-8 Clans
Bronze Medal:
#9-20 Clans
Every member in your clan gets the
prize
!
Exclusive
🔮 Mega Lucky Gamepass
The
luck ladder
gets a brand-new
top rung
!
Mega Lucky
boosts your egg luck by a massive
800%
!
It stacks right on top of
Lucky
and
Ultra Lucky
.
That makes it the
biggest
luck boost in the game!
💥 Lucky Block Breaker
Rip through
Lucky Blocks with this exclusive
enchant
!
Lucky Block Breaker
doubles
the damage you deal them!
It works on your
board
and out in the
worlds
.
🙂 Lucky Noob Egg
Skip the grind
with the
Lucky Noob Egg
!
It hatches the
Lucky Peacock
,
Hydra Noob
, and
Demon
!
Push your luck for the
HUGE Lucky Surprise Unicorn
!
Or land the
TITANIC Lucky Block Hydra Noob
!
Grab
10
or
100
to stack
Exclusive Raffle Tickets
!
Limited-time only - don't miss your chance!
❓ Mystery Pack
Stock up with the brand-new
Mystery Pack
!
Packed with
3 Lucky Noob Eggs
,
5 Lucky Bags
, and
3 Exclusive Eggs
.
Loaded with
500 MILLION
Diamonds and a
Titanic XP Potion
!
Plus
100 Raffle Tickets
and a stack of
Mega Chests
!
Limited-time only!
🌈 The Forever Pack
The
Forever Pack
just got its
biggest overhaul
ever!
Every reward was
reworked
, and there's way more packed inside.
The only place to get the
Lucky Block Hoverboard
and
Booth
!
Score the
GARGANTUAN Lucky Block Shark
and
TITANIC Lucky Surprise Cat
!
Plus the
HUGE Lucky Stacked Capybara
, and the event chase pets too!
Stocked with
Lucky Noob Eggs
,
Boosts
, and
2 BILLION
Diamonds!
Every single tier drops the new
Lucky Bag
, even the free one!
Limited-time only - smash while you can!
📦 Exclusive Cardboard Egg
Fold out
the new
Exclusive Cardboard Egg
!
Every cardboard pet
teeters
corner to corner as it walks!
Leave one standing and it
topples flat
on its face!
Presenting the
GARGANTUAN Cardboard Dominus Astra
and
TITANIC Cardboard Floppa
!
Hatch the
Huge Cardboard Shark
and
Huge Cardboard Blobfish
!
Plus the
Cardboard Shark
,
Cardboard Maskot
, and
Cardboard Blobfish
.
Only available for a limited time - don't miss out!
GET LUCKY!
~ Preston & PS99 Dev Team
